# Will this solar quote pay for itself?

> Free solar panel payback calculator for homeowners. Enter system cost, incentives, production and your electricity rates to see payback year, 25-year net gain, NPV and IRR, and how a lower export credit changes it. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
